name: @pipeworx/mcp-isbn

tools.name: validate_isbn
tools.description: Validate an ISBN-10 or ISBN-13 (keyless, offline): detects the format and checks the check digit (ISBN-10 uses mod-11 with an "X" for 10). Hyphens/spaces ignored. Validates the number, not the book.

tools.name: convert_isbn
tools.description: Convert an ISBN between ISBN-10 and ISBN-13 (recomputing the check digit). ISBN-10 -> ISBN-13 prefixes "978"; ISBN-13 -> ISBN-10 works only for the 978 prefix.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-isbn forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the isbn pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
